problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 15 infrastructure projects to maximize the total expected community benefit.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: expected benefit is 0.097, disruption level is 0.221, allocation bounds [0.017, 0.392]  
* Project B: expected benefit is 0.090, disruption level is 0.130, allocation bounds [0.046, 0.480]  
* Project C: expected benefit is 0.022, disruption level is 0.252, allocation bounds [0.057, 0.684]  
* Project D: expected benefit is 0.082, disruption level is 0.183, allocation bounds [0.091, 0.682]  
* Project E: expected benefit is 0.075, disruption level is 0.052, allocation bounds [0.020, 0.375]  
* Project F: expected benefit is 0.100, disruption level is 0.098, allocation bounds [0.083, 0.700]  
* Project G: expected benefit is 0.121, disruption level is 0.297, allocation bounds [0.029, 0.473]  
* Project H: expected benefit is 0.059, disruption level is 0.162, allocation bounds [0.049, 0.408]  
* Project I: expected benefit is 0.180, disruption level is 0.107, allocation bounds [0.082, 0.844]  
* Project J: expected benefit is 0.153, disruption level is 0.281, allocation bounds [0.030, 0.687]  
* Project K: expected benefit is 0.095, disruption level is 0.181, allocation bounds [0.059, 0.317]  
* Project L: expected benefit is 0.100, disruption level is 0.119, allocation bounds [0.049, 0.759]  
* Project M: expected benefit is 0.049, disruption level is 0.012, allocation bounds [0.074, 0.596]  
* Project N: expected benefit is 0.151, disruption level is 0.195, allocation bounds [0.022, 0.882]  
* Project O: expected benefit is 0.182, disruption level is 0.089, allocation bounds [0.079, 0.659]  

Each project must receive a proportion of the total budget within its specified allocation bounds, and the sum of all budget proportions must equal one. To ensure equitable regional development, the group of high-visibility projects, represented by the subset H = {A, C, E, F, G, L}, must collectively receive at least 0.256 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall disruption index of the portfolio must not exceed 0.190, and the total expected benefit must be at least 0.074.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes total expected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
